meta.title: Sidebar annotate
meta.description: Box regions on whatever the DSH sidebar is showing — a web page, PDF, Word/PPT, Markdown, txt, code, image or Excel — write notes, and drop crops plus a prompt anchored by page, line or cell range into the composer. For a single sentence, select it, right-click and pick Annotate: one line, no crop. Sent notes stay in a per-session ledger and can be inserted again or jumped back to.
